description: Research r15 (AWS box 1, 8x B200, two runs per GPU; dev only), added 2026-10-25 18:46 in place of advnone_st800 (r10 closed): the control mal0_st800 with the cosine over 500 steps instead of 800 (budget_steps 500; each step counts as 34.8 s of the 17,400-s budget). This follows r14 seed 0's lr path by step (4.1e-7 at step 300, 2.9e-7 at 350, 1.9e-7 at 400; r14 logged 4.25e-7, 2.82e-7, 1.60e-7): r14 seed 0's sampling ran 2.2x slower than r5's, so its time-based cosine had annealed by the steps where r5's seeds collapsed at lr 3.2-5.3e-7, and it ended at dev 0.398 (best 0.410). Tests whether that lower lr per step, not TIS (which clipped ~1e-5 of tokens), kept it from collapsing.
